task.title: To promote a clause to the Clause Library

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open your document.
In the Contracts pane go to Work > Promote Clauses. If you cannot see Promote Clauses under the Work tab, click the More icon () and from the menu, select Promote Clauses.
From the list of marked clauses, select the clause you want to promote to the clause library and click Promote Clause.

info.p: The Promote Clause form inherits field values from the marked clause.

step.cmd: You can change the following field values based on your requirement.

entry.p: Enter a new name of the clause.
Select a category for your clause. The values of the categories are defined by your admin and help in filtering the clauses. The picklist is displayed from the Agreement clause object.

ul.li: The values of the Agreement object and Agreement Clauses object must match.
If the Category and Subcategory do not match the Template object, then you must manually select the category and subcategory when marking a clause.

entry.p: Select a subcategory for your clause. Options in the list will change based on the category you selected. The picklist is displayed from the Agreement clause object.

ul.li: The values of the Agreement object and Agreement Clauses object must match.
If the Category and Subcategory do not match the Template object, then you must manually select the category and subcategory when marking a clause.

entry.p: Enter a new description or modify the existing description for the clause. Maximum of 255 characters (an error will be thrown if this limit is exceeded).
Enter new guidance or modify existing guidance to help users determine the purpose of the clause.
Enter comma-separated keywords to associate with the template. Keywords make it easier to search the templates.

postreq.p: You have promoted the clause to the Clause Library. You can open the Clause Library and search the promoted clause to use it in any other document or template.

ul.li: When Template Versioning is enabled and you promote a clause to Clause Library, the system automatically creates an active version (v1.00) of the clause template. For more information about Template Versioning, see Template Versioning topic in this guide.
